items.title: Kvlar – Open-source firewall for AI agent tool calls
items.raw_excerpt:
Hey HN, I built Kvlar — an open-source policy engine that sits between AI agents and their tools (MCP servers), evaluating every tool call against YAML security policies before execution. The problem: AI agents using MCP can execute database queries, push code, send Slack messages, and run shell commands — with no security boundary. Claude Desktop has basic approve/deny, but it's per-call with no persistent rules, no automation, and no audit trail. How it works: Kvlar runs as a stdio proxy between the agent and the MCP server. You define policies in YAML — allow, deny, or require human approval — and Kvlar enforces them deterministically. Fail-closed: if no rule matches, the action is denied. kvlar init --template postgres # curated policy (11 rules)
kvlar wrap # inject proxy into Claude D

On March 3, iCAR and Horizon Robotics jointly held an intelligent driving technology launch event, showcasing the assisted driving capabilities of the new mass-produced model iCAR V27 equipped with Horizon SuperDrive™, a full-scenario assisted driving system. Dr. Su Jun, General Manager of the iCAR Brand Division, and Dr. Yu Kai, Founder and CEO of Horizon Robotics, appeared at the event to jointly interpret the real-world road test performance of this family-oriented rugged SUV in complex multi-city scenarios.

With flagship computing power and a true single-stage end-to-end system, the iCAR V27 is powered by the Horizon Journey 6P chip, delivering a single-chip computing power of 560 TOPS and paired with 27 high-precision sensors, including lidar. Horizon's self-developed next-generation BPU Nash architecture is deeply optimized for real-time inference of Transformer large models, ensuring seamless integration of chips and algorithms. The innovative storage and control systems significantly enhance data processing efficiency, reduce system latency, and enable continuous learning. Ample computing power redundancy provides room for long-term OTA evolution of the vehicle.

On the software front, Horizon SuperDrive adopts China's first mass-produced true single-stage end-to-end system. While traditional rule-based algorithms rely on the mechanical splicing of different control modules, the single-stage end-to-end approach achieves ultra-low latency from photon input to trajectory output. The system is 42% faster than the average human reaction time, enabling quicker responses to unexpected situations. The deeply coupled longitudinal and lateral control of the single-stage end-to-end system reduces undesirable behaviors such as light braking, hard braking, and "weaving" by over 90%, minimizing motion sickness for passengers.

El Dr. Su Jun, director general de la división de marca iCAR, y el Dr. Yu Kai, fundador y CEO de Horizon Robotics, estuvieron presentes en el evento, explicando conjuntamente las pruebas en carretera de este SUV familiar todoterreno en complejos escenarios urbanos múltiples. Con potencia de cálculo insignia + verdadera arquitectura de extremo a extremo en una sola etapa, el iCAR V27 incorpora el chip Journey 6P de Horizon Robotics, con una potencia de cálculo de 560 TOPS por unidad, combinado con 27 sensores de alta precisión (incluido láser).
